languages.coverageRule: Measure availability and fallback per artifact; blank labels or planned links do not count as a published translation.

vendor.name: California Department of Education
vendor.basis: Official CDE directory URL keyed by the district CDS entity code.

cadence.expectation: Check before identity or school-roster releases.

sources.archiveNotes: CDE warns that directory details are self-reported and may be stale.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official pages identify Finalsite in the site footer.

cadence.expectation: Monitor configured high-value pages; do not crawl every school site by default.

sources.archiveNotes: The site is large and repeats navigation content; adapters must scope extraction to the content region.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official board page on the district's identified Finalsite site.

cadence.expectation: Use for discovery and check around every scheduled board meeting.

sources.archiveNotes: This is a navigation hub; meeting records are organized on separate school-year pages.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official page and Finalsite footer; no separate agenda-portal vendor is exposed on the index.

cadence.expectation: Check after each meeting and revisit until minutes and all recording parts are published.

sources.archiveNotes: School-year pages expose English, Spanish, Hmong, Q&A, minutes, and one or more recording links, but some labels can be present without a live link.

vendor.name: IBM
vendor.basis: Official archive pages link recording parts to video.ibm.com.

cadence.expectation: Discover every linked part and reconcile ordered parts to one meeting.

sources.archiveNotes: A meeting may have one, two, or three recordings. Multipart video is a first-class relationship, not duplicate meetings.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official finance page on the district Finalsite site.

cadence.expectation: Check adopted budget, revisions, interim reports, unaudited actuals, and audit milestones.

sources.archiveNotes: Financial documents are split across landing, statements, presentations, and revisions pages; preserve the originating collection.

vendor.name: Finalsite
vendor.basis: Official calendar page on the district Finalsite site.

cadence.expectation: Check each school year and compare printable, accessible, and event representations.

sources.archiveNotes: The district separately publishes printable and accessible calendars and an archived-calendar page.

vendor.name: Nutrislice
vendor.basis: Official Fresno Unified Nutrition Services pages direct families to this tenant.

cadence.expectation: Discover menus by site and preserve retrieval time and service date.

sources.archiveNotes: Treat menus as operational data; verify site and meal-period identity before comparing across schools.

sourceRegimes.notes: Official navigation exposes school-year archives back to 2014-15; platform contract and earlier coverage remain unknown.
Do not infer when IBM Video became the provider until archive sampling establishes bounds.

sampleTargets.selection: Regular, special, and atypical meetings, including examples with one, two, and three recording parts.
Record live-link availability for English, Spanish, and Hmong per artifact rather than trusting labels.
Adopted budget, revisions, interim reports, unaudited actuals, and audit where available.
Compare printable, accessible, event, and subscription representations.
Sample elementary, middle, high, and special-program sites without assuming one shared menu.

successSignals: The custom Finalsite meeting index can be normalized without district-specific editorial code.
Multipart IBM recordings remain ordered parts of one meeting.
Language coverage reports distinguish live artifacts from empty or future placeholders.
Runtime and storage estimates are measured at large-district volume.

openQuestions: Establish the earliest complete meeting year and any pre-Finalsite source regimes.
Determine whether support-material pages have a stable machine-readable interface or require constrained HTML extraction.
Identify all board and committee bodies that share the archive and which are in pilot scope.
Determine the Hmong language variety and terminology-review process without inferring it from a generic site label.
